reason.busy: Busy: wait for the current task
reason.debugOnly: Turn on debug mode in Settings first

groundMenu.label: Ground actions

facts.bare: Unsurveyed ground or a gap between parcels: nobody's land that we know of.
facts.noCadastre: No parcel data here. A proposal can only execute through an authority's verdict.

groundMenu.notLoaded: Parcels are not loaded here yet — zoom in or wait for them to load.

hint.drawing: Click to add corners (they snap to parcel and building outlines; hold Alt not to). Click the first corner or press Enter to finish. Backspace removes the last corner, Esc cancels.
hint.editing: Drag corners to reshape, click an edge to add one. Then build on the site.
hint.plots: Plots are cut along the frontage edge (by default the one facing a street, else the longest). Click another edge of the site to use it instead.

editor.vertexTitle: Drag to move · click an edge to add a corner

binding.noParcels: Binds no parcel: it can only execute through an authority's verdict.
binding.openGround: Hatched: open ground nobody can consent for; executing needs an authority's verdict.
binding.touched: Reaches {{width}} into {{parcel}} — below the tolerance, not bound.
binding.smallIntrusion: Reaches {{width}} into {{parcel}} — include it, or change the design.
binding.previewSkipped: Too many parcels around this site for a preview; waiting for the server.
binding.serverFailed: Could not check with the server: {{reason}}
binding.previewOnly: Preview from the parcels loaded on the map.
binding.serverNoCadastre: Confirmed by the server: no cadastre covers this place.

coverage.complete: complete — the whole site lies on cadastral parcels
coverage.partial: partial — part of the site is open ground (no parcel)
coverage.none: none — no parcels here; the whole site is open ground
coverage.partialAll: partial — the whole site is open ground: no parcel here, though the cadastre covers the area

palette.readjustNeedsParcels: Land readjustment works on selected parcels: select them instead of drawing a site.
palette.readjustUnknownCadastre: Subdividing needs a cadastre the server holds: this place has none it knows.

plots.frontagePick: Click to use this edge as the frontage

errors.tooFew: A site needs at least three corners.
errors.tooMany: A site can have at most 500 corners.
errors.selfIntersecting: The outline crosses itself; move a corner so it does not.
errors.reshapeSplit: That would split the site in two; edit its corners instead.
errors.mapBusy: Finish the tool that is open first.
errors.parcelsUnavailable: Those parcels are not on the map.

frontage.pending: Looking for the street this site faces…
frontage.facingUnnamed: Frontage facing an unnamed street ({{distance}} m away).
frontage.longestNoStreet: Frontage: the longest edge (no street within {{distance}} m).
frontage.longestNoData: Frontage: the longest edge (street data is unavailable here).

groundStats.openGroundNote: Open ground: {{area}} m² of the sites has no cadastral parcels; parcel figures cover the bound parcels only.
groundStats.grainNoParcels: No parcels here: these proposals stand on open ground, so there are no resulting parcels to score.

parcelCompare.title: Compare proposals on parcel {{number}}
parcelCompare.needTwo: At least two proposals must touch this parcel to compare them.
parcelCompare.previewLabel: Parcel outline with each proposal’s ground on it

relation.intrudes: Its site reaches in without naming this parcel

bar.hint: Tick two proposals to compare them on this parcel

parcelSources.title: Choose a parcel source
parcelSources.intro: Add a public HTTPS parcel URL for this city. We try each supported format and check that it can return complete parcel boundaries.
parcelSources.conform: Conform your source so it can be read by one of the adapters.
parcelSources.formats: See the source formats we understand
parcelSources.request: Ask us to add another adapter, which we sometimes do.
parcelSources.matched: Adapter found: {{adapter}}. {{count}} parcels in the test area. Coverage outside this area depends on the source.
parcelSources.invalidUrl: Use a public HTTPS URL without credentials or access keys.
parcelSources.checkFailed: Could not finish checking the URL. Check your connection and try again.
parcelSources.storageFailed: The source choice could not be saved in this browser.

parcelSourceHealth.offline: You appear to be offline. Connect to the internet and try again.
parcelSourceHealth.rateLimited: This parcel source is rate limited. Retry in {{seconds}} seconds.
parcelSourceHealth.blocked: The provider denied access (HTTP {{status}}). It may restrict IP addresses or require authentication. Choose another source or try again later.
parcelSourceHealth.timeout: This parcel source timed out. Try again shortly.
parcelSourceHealth.unavailable: This parcel source is temporarily unavailable.
parcelSourceHealth.loadedRemain: Already loaded parcels remain visible. Retry or choose another source.

buildingSources.title: Choose a building source
buildingSources.intro: Add a public HTTPS URL of building footprints for this city, or of an OpenStreetMap mirror (an Overpass API address ending in /interpreter). We try each supported format and read a height or storey field when it has one; other heights are estimated.
buildingSources.matched: Adapter found: {{adapter}}. {{count}} buildings in the test area. Coverage outside this area depends on the source.
buildingSources.levelsOnly: Heights from the storey field {{field}}, 3 m per storey.
buildingSources.noHeights: This source has no height field; heights are estimated.
buildingSources.overpass: An OpenStreetMap mirror: heights come from OpenStreetMap where mapped and are estimated elsewhere.
buildingSources.osmUnavailable: Building data could not be loaded right now: the OpenStreetMap server is busy.
buildingSources.customUnavailable: Your building source did not answer, so buildings could not be loaded here.
buildingSources.unavailable: Building data could not be loaded right now.
buildingSources.tryAgainIn: Try again in about {{minutes}} min, or plug in your own mirror or source.
buildingSources.tryAgainLater: Try again later, or plug in your own mirror or source.
